definitions.ask: Should zorg-era legacy sections move out of the area notes into new legacy_<area> notebooks?
definitions.why: Repeats your 2026-11-02 abby → legacy_dad move; area notes keep only live content

choices.label: Move them verbatim into 8 legacy_<area> notebooks; rewrite ~320 links in ~136 files
Leave them at the bottom of each area note; no new notebooks, no moved-link rewrites

definitions.ask: Should the converter's other keys (id, aliases, tags, inbox's status and area) go too?
definitions.why: No newer area note has them, and nothing in bob or the vault reads them on area notes

choices.label: Remove them from 5 notes; the Meetings alias and frontmatter-tag search hits go away
Remove only the 7 zorg keys; the converter keys stay

definitions.ask: Should legacy_job.md get back the two zorg-era job entries cut from job.md on 2026-10-12?
definitions.why: legacy_job.md was made a minute before the cut to hold those notes, and says so

choices.label: Copy them from git history into legacy_job.md, so 5 dangling job.md links resolve
legacy_job.md stays a one-line stub, and those 5 links keep dangling
